name: API Ninjas
label: API Ninjas Reference
description: Official API Ninjas reference subset only: quotes (v2), trivia, facts, jokes, riddles, bucketlist (v1). Header X-Api-Key. Not the whole 140-API catalog. Quotes may be third-party copyright. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-invoke fields for API Ninjas. Do not put secrets here. Example: {"operation":"quotes"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Overrides config operation. EXACT: quotes | trivia | facts | jokes | riddles | bucketlist. Example: 'quotes'.

ports.name: output
ports.description: OfficialApiNode result: {status,http_status,data} on 2xx. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: status
schema.description: Present on HTTP 2xx. EXACT: 'ok'. Absent on failure. Example: 'ok'.

schema.label: http_status
schema.description: HTTP status from the provider. Example: 200.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body (or raw text if not JSON). OfficialApiNode places the provider payload here. Example: provider object.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when input.operation is blank. EXACT: quotes | trivia | facts | jokes | riddles | bucketlist. Example: 'quotes'.

configurationParameters.label: Api Key
configurationParameters.description: API Ninjas X-Api-Key. Commercial use needs a paid plan. https://api-ninjas.com/

configurationParameters.label: Timeout Seconds
configurationParameters.description: Connect+read timeout seconds. Default 25. <=0 falls back to 25. Example: 25.
